_comment: Dataset v2 target-vs-actual 3D plot presets. Every id/value below was read from the real Dataset v2 work root and its development/cand_D_pure_dls evaluation run on 2026-07-27 -- nothing here is synthetic. Regenerate this file (see selection_rule) if the dataset or evaluation run is regenerated.

generated_from.note: cand_D_pure_dls is the pre-registered candidate actually selected by evaluation_v2/selection.py and locked for the frozen_test run (see docs/V2_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md Phase 8A/8B and KR810_Tier0_Tier4_Dataset_v2.0.0/evaluation_protocol.json). Its 'warm_start' method column is Dataset v2's warm-start DLS.

selection_rule: 1. Filter core_trajectory_manifest.csv / challenge_trajectory_manifest.csv rows by the preset's shape/orientation_mode (core) or challenge_family (challenge).
2. Sort surviving rows by trajectory_id (lexical, ascending).
4. Filter trials/trial_manifest.csv rows to trial_id == '<trajectory_id>_trial_<difficulty>' (exactly one row per trajectory per difficulty by construction -- 3 trials/trajectory, spec section J).
5. Sort by trial_id (lexical, ascending) -- a no-op here since step 4 already narrows to one row, but kept for determinism if a future filter is loosened.
7. Look up that trial_id's 400 waypoint rows in tier2_sequential_dls/waypoint_results.csv, method == 'warm_start' (warm-start DLS), sorted by waypoint_id ascending.

8. target_position_{x,y,z}/target_quaternion_q{w,x,y,z} = the requested Cartesian target trajectory; actual_position_{x,y,z}/actual_quaternion_q{w,x,y,z} = the DLS-achieved trajectory from that same evaluation run.

No best-case cherry-picking: selection never inspects position_error_m, success flags, or any other outcome column before picking the trajectory/trial -- only identity/metadata fields (shape, orientation_mode, challenge_family, split membership implied by anchor/trajectory generation) are used as filters.

easy.description: Core trajectory, line shape, fixed orientation, easy initial state, warm-start DLS.

medium.description: Core trajectory, helix shape, variable orientation, medium initial state, warm-start DLS.

hard.description: Random-challenge trajectory, non_planar family, hard initial state, warm-start DLS.
